_comment: Featured projects, in README order. status: live | in-progress | open-source. Edit and the Charts workflow redraws the cards. Links live in README.md.

projects.name: FinLoan Admin
projects.description: Admin system for banks and NBFIs: browse, search and filter loans, register new ones, drill into details. Per-tenant name, colors and branding, reusable UI blocks, fully responsive.

projects.name: TradeJournal
projects.description: Log trades, results and mental state, then analyze them. REST API, auth, PostgreSQL, analytics and personal AI insights powered by the Claude API.

projects.name: LendFlow Lite
projects.description: Loan applications, rule-based credit scoring, admin review, disbursement and EMI schedules. @Transactional updates keep account, loan and ledger atomic. JWT auth, Docker Compose.

projects.name: NEYRA
projects.tagline: AI vision board -> daily action plan
projects.description: Turns a vision board and goals into AI-generated steps, then tracks daily progress with photos. Auth, database, image storage and AI features wired into one system.

projects.name: FinTech Transaction API
projects.description: Users, accounts, income, expenses and account-to-account transfers with balance checks, transaction history and atomic DB transactions. BigDecimal for every money value.

projects.name: FinTech Dashboard
projects.description: Built from the BankDash Figma kit: dashboard, transactions, accounts, customers, analytics and settings. Recharts charts, React Router, Zustand state, fully responsive.
